videos.title: Villa Turco Berti
videos.description: A cinematic tour of Villa Turco Berti a 17th-century boutique hotel & spa in the heart of Caldiero, just a few minutes from Verona.

videos.title: Casa Larimar
videos.description: Casa Larimar, Verona. A visual story of what happens in the kitchen before a dish reaches the table: the gestures, the timing, the focus. No staging - just the chefs at work, filmed as it is.

videos.title: Masai Mara
videos.description: The film opens with images of the Maasai tribe: men, women, and children living according to age-old traditions, in harmony with nature. The camera then shifts to the African savanna, with its boundless landscapes and wildlife. Every shot becomes a poetic fragment: the slow breath of the earth, the ancestral sounds, the dance of light across the landscape.

videos.title: FCM 30
videos.description: A glimpse of one night told like a film. Thirty years, dressed in white, light and rhythm: the teaser of the short event film for FCM 30.

videos.title: Rhythmic Cinema
videos.description: The dribble keeps time in black and white. The dancer answers in saturated color, locked to the beat of the cut.

videos.title: Do Not Kill
videos.description: This song is a political and humanitarian denunciation. It does not target any people, ethnicity or religion.

videos.title: Intimate
videos.description: An intimate cinematic edit - exploring light, texture and emotion in a fashion editorial atmosphere.

videos.title: Time
videos.description: An AI-generated cinematic short that explores the timeless allure of iconic design through the lens of artificial intelligence.

videos.title: Nessuno Come Te
videos.description: An introspective journey between melancholy and self-awareness, where the void left by an absence becomes a reflection of an inner search. Produced by T-EST Music, the track explores the difficulty of finding oneself when one loses one's way and the heart learns to be alone, even in a different place.

videos.title: Bad Girl

videos.title: Vita da Rockstar
videos.description: The video centers on a high-energy playback performance. The artist is front-and-center, delivering aggressive, fast-paced delivery directly into a wide-angle lens. The focus is on raw movement, energy, and intense expressions that drive the rhythm of the edit.

videos.title: Showreel
